clare-people-ops: Quick follow-up from All-Hands travel/workspace Qs 1. Dropping answers and next steps here.

nina-eng: Thanks! Can managers approve premium economy for 6hr flights without exec signoff?

clare-people-ops: Yes for 5-8hr flights managers can pre-approve premium economy. Anything >8hr or multi-leg overnight needs director+finance signoff. Will add examples to handbook.

mike-ops: Desk pilot note: reservation limits are 3 days/week during pilot and team zones reserved for rostered days. If you need an exception for a critical week, ping ops with dates.

anna-ceo: Leadership ask: produce an "Offsite Playbook" draft by end of next week with booking templates + accessibility checklist.

travel-bot: Reminder: submit expenses within 30 days of travel to avoid delays. Link: https://intranet.redwood/expenses

clare-people-ops: Adding childcare stipend pilot details to the draft. Anyone with edge-case questions DM me. :wave:
